Uttar Pradesh Cabinet Approves Name Change for Jalalabad City

The Uttar Pradesh government has approved a proposal to rename Jalalabad city as Parshuram Puri. The decision was made during the cabinet meeting, where 28 vital proposals were also approved. The renaming is part of efforts to promote tourism and cultural heritage in the region. The move is expected to have an impact on local businesses and residents.
